notes.title: V0.8555 Updates
Join WotN2 speedrun contest!
notes.content:
Hello, Warriors!
The game has been launched for a week now, thank you for your support and like. The speedrun contest of Warriors of the Nile 2 is coming now! We have prepared two challenge modes for you, with different rewards for different difficulty~
Come and win your customized morph character, Steam gift card and more!

Contest Time; Sep. 2ed -Sep. 20th 

Contest Rules：
Speedrun the Game! Finish the game and the final time that system collected will be your score. We will rank according to the scores.
Warriors can choose any trial mode to participate in.

Normal Trial
You can use any Warrior in your squad.
No need to add challenge and please keep the default difficulty.

Hard Trial
You can’t use morph warrior.
 The challenge mode should be set at the highest level 65 (check all!).

Detailed Rules
1. You can submit your score multiple times, and the score you submitted the last time is your final score.
2. You need to submit your score, recorded footage, victory screenshot, saving file, ID and Discord ID. Your ID is used to display on the ranking list. Please do not use offensive ID and the official has the right to block bad IDs.
3. You can’t unlock Hero Trials when challenging. 
4. MOD, trainer, change gear wheel and other software that affect the game and cheating are prohibited. Once found, the result will be canceled.
5. Hard Trial need to be unlocked in Hard Mode.
6. If the finish time is the same, priority will be given to who submits the score first.
7. The contest will end at 24:00 on September 20, UTC+8.
8. For more details, please join Warriors of the Nile 2 Discord. The ranking list will update every 2 days on 17:00, UTC+8.
9. During the event, due to the update needs of the game version, minor balance adjustments will still be made to some tables and props, and the previous achievements will not be cancelled. At the same time, the warriors are encouraged to continue to challenge. The update is to make the game more perfect, and the impact of this will be respected. Thank you for your understanding.
10. Gamera Games reserves the right of final interpretation of this contest.

Way to Join
Recorded footage, victory screenshot and savingfile of the winning playthrough are needed, please send the materials to support@gameragame.com.

Prizes
Normal Trial
No.1 $200 Steam gift card
No.2 $180 Steam gift card
No.3 $170 Steam gift card
No.4-10 $20 Steam gift card
No.11-20 $10 Steam gift card

Hard Trial
No.1 A customized morph character + $250 Steam gift card
No.2 $200 Steam gift card
No.3 $50 Steam gift card
No.4-10 $30 Steam gift card

Prizes Awarded

1.Within 14 working days after the event ends, the official will contact the corresponding warriors via email to obtain your contact information and issue prizes.
2.The customized morph character needs to be communicated and designed with the winner, and the final decision belongs to the developer. Due to the special workload of the customized morph character, the published time shall be communicated according to the actual situation.

Q&A about Warriors of the Nile 2
notes.content:
Q：What’s the location of saving file and log file?
A: C:\Users\...\AppData\LocalLow\StoveStudio\Warriors Of The Nile 2  
in the file folder of saving and log.

Q: What can I do if the frame of Warriors of the Nile 2 is too high and the fan rotates quickly?
A: Find your NVIDIA control panel, and in 3D settings - adjust image settings with preview, adjusting the option to "determined by 3D application"

Q: What can I do if I meet bugs or system breakdown?
A: If you have any problems, you can tell us from discord. https://discord.gg/uykMdxD
If you can’t exit the game, you can press ALT+F4 together to exit.

Q: Can I select characters as I like?
A: Nope. Fighter, hunters and mage, you can choose one of each type.

Q: What’s the usage of blue gems after each battle?
A: You can upgrade buildings, and you will get better tablets, weapons and cavings.

Q: How can I unlock the collaboration character Icarus?
A: You should clear the game one time and unlock the pyramid.

Q: Are there any differences in the levels of the tablets?
A: Green<Blue<Purple<Gold in normal situation, but you should think about the cooperation among the tablets during the battle.

Q: How can I unlock the equipment rack during battle?
A: You can find a weapon master in the map.

Q: How to check previous battle records and attributes of tablets and equipment?
A: You can build library from building, after building the library, you can check previous battle records and attributes of tablets and equipment.

Q: How to get colorful tablets?
A: The tablets you meet during the game will be recorded in the tablets collection, you can get colorful tablets when select the tablet and clear the game.

Q: How to get locked tablets? 
A: The locked tablets are divided into ordinary and challenge. You can get ordinary tablets by unlocking the oracle with the character points obtained by clearing the game. Challenge tablets need to unlock all the contents of the character to unlock the challenge. After completing the challenge, you can get the corresponding challenge tablets.

Q: How to get more EXP for building？
A：The EXP required for building is obtained after battle clearance or battle failure, and its quantity is connected with the number of defeated elites, the number of weapons obtained, the number of Pharaoh coins after battle clearance or battle failure, and the medals obtained after battle clearance or battle failure. In addition, if you give up the expedition and return to the main city when there is an ongoing journey, the previous round will not settle the reward, and the game will not be recorded in the record. Please note that.

Q：Why I didn’t buy any weapons or equipment, they also be collected into illustrated handbook?
A: They are different with character tablets, if you meet weapons and equipment in the game, they will be collected into illustrated handbook, they should not be bought or equipped to clear the game.

Q: I clear the game but I didn’t unlock the Great Hero achievements (defeat all Bosses)? Why?
A: There are 6 Bosses in total, clear the game once only can defeat 3 Bosses, and Bosses refresh randomly, if you are lucky, you can unlock this achievement only by clearing the game twice.

Q: Well-Read achievement need colorful tablets collection 100% or not?
A: Nope. It only need tablet collection 100%.

notes.title: Warriors of the Nile 2 will launch on August 24th
notes.content:
Hi Warriors,

We have kept you waiting for a long time. The dispute over the Nile is finally about to officially begin. Warriors of the Nile 2, produced by Stove Studio, will be released on Steam on August 24th. At present, the game is in the final polishing stage, improving and optimizing the game experience. At the same time, there are more hidden Easter eggs waiting for you to discover, oh, this is not yet announced, next time~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/25cd60426b1636ffa1a7c8ffec5c5b385f1d0bb6.png[/img]

As a fast-paced roguelite strategic game, what we pay attention to is if we let everyone find cheerfulness in the game. If you have played the original Warriors of the Nile, you must not be too strange to us. On this small chessboard, control your three characters, challenge the incoming enemy, form a unique character ability combination with various tablets, weapons, accessories, etc. What are you waiting for? Why not wishlist it immediately :)

In Warriors of the Nile 2, there are nine warriors with unique abilities for everyone to choose. They form a three-person team to break through all levels of difficulties. What kind of challenges are waiting for you? Hum, not here.

So warriors, August 24th, be there or be square!

notes.title: Warriors of the Nile 2 DEMO is available now & Early Access Preview
notes.content:
Warriors, the army of Rome is coming! Take up your arms, sense the power of the gods and resist enemy's invasion!

In Warriors of the Nile 2 DEMO, you can try four characters and one full level. Elite enemies in easy mode and plenty of random tablet skills can bring you a different experience for each game. Have fun! If you find any bugs and have feedback related to the game, please join https://discord.gg/uykMdxD and talk it to us.

It has been more than a year since the release of Warriors of the Nile. When the sequel was announced, we received a lot of enthusiastic feedback combined with questions. The following contents may relieve some of your questions about the Early Access version of Warriors of the Nile in advance.

-Nine unique characters. In Warriors of the Nile, only the base tablet (skills) cam be changed. However, in the DEMO of Warriors of the Nile2, the nine characters have their exclusive tablets for you to combine your very own skill combo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/ea68ff0cb56ffaa7a87e1b9d955c2cf3df5b3024.png[/img]

-Exclusive talent trees. Use the permanent points to enhance and develop your characters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/44114eabb80c84a5c720a712c17ced8dfe9ae5ee.png[/img]

-Equipment system. Hundreds of weapons and dozens of accessories are waiting for its warrior.

-The talisman system (TBD). Talismans can be inlay to upgrade and strengthen weapons and equipment.

-Elite enemies. The battlefield is full of crises. Should you wait or merch on? Use your strategic mind and judge calmly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/72e060d3bafcc73fd42b73ff03d05f6c4a9e28ee.png[/img]

We have also implemented some of our regrets in the previous game and researching on the Steam Workshop and Endless Mode make Warriors of the Nile2 present in a better status.

In order to thank all players who support the game series, all players who own Warriors of the Niles will enjoy a royal discount when buying Warriors of the Nile2. In addition to the discount, players who already own the previous game before December 31, 2021 will also receive a non-sale exclusive skin.

Wishlist us is the best support for us, thank you! Stay tuned!

notes.title: We’re back with Warriors of the Nile 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/2b6028bc684ccda5077a9c6bb3c096e5614fb798.jpg[/img]

Hey Warriors,

It’s quite a long time since the last announcement. We miss you badly!

We have heard some voices that said we have abandoned the game. Don’t worry, it will never happen! In fact, we adjusted the team during that time, studying the pros and cons of the original Warriors of the Nile, to bring you a better sequel.

Based on Roguelite x Strategy gameplay, Warriors of the Nile 2 will bring much more content and randomness. Every playable character will have his/her unique system which could be the game-changer at the crucial moment! More details will be revealed during Tokyo Game Show.

At last, thank you all for your support! August 7th will be the anniversary of Warriors of the Nile’s release, we will celebrate it with a -40% discount for the game.

See you soon!
